sourceFile: 14. TIU L5S3-01 R Result test New spot tip - date 2025.12.01_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft misgroups a three spot-tip NG-rate test as a single unclear baseline-vs-Test 1 comparison.
issues: Baseline/changed factor is not supported by source rows.
Test 2 and Test 3 results are omitted from outcomes.
Outcome metric is mislabeled as Picture sample instead of NG rate.
Changed-condition grouping should reflect three spot tip tests.
Decision row is cited but its content is unavailable.
requiredUserQuestions: Do Test 1, Test 2, and Test 3 represent the three spot tip types?
Is any test the baseline/current tip, or are all three alternative tips?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to spot tip type/test condition.
Include Test 1, Test 2, and Test 3 under one validation context.
Use input, OK, NG, total NG, and NG rate as outcomes.
Avoid claiming a baseline unless confirmed by evidence or user.
Add decision content only if row 33 has citeable text.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are sufficient for purpose and results but insufficient for baseline and final decision.
